solution_summary: With 38 branches across the country and 8 million active deals, Icatu already had a business intelligence structure, but in 2020, mainly due to the increase in the volume of information and the need to give more autonomy to users, it realized that it needed to raise the level of its solution in order to have a positive impact on partners, brokers, and customers The insurer carried out a comprehensive program for modernizing its data architecture, evolving its business intelligence environment, adopting a hybrid architecture with Microsoft Cloud tools with support from partner company Informatica, and realizing several benefits from the solution.
